note: Crossing points of the Gaza Strip. Positions from OCHA oPt (HDX, 2019 and 2021) except where marked approximate. Status as reported by OCHA on 29 October 2026 and the sources named. Not plotted (positions not published in the sources checked): Zikim (aid, opened April 2024, closed 24 May 2026, OCHA), Kissufim and Gate 96 (emergency aid routes opened in 2024).

crossings.name: Rafah crossing
crossings.use: People (and, during the 2023–25 war, aid trucks)
crossings.status_text: Reopened on 2 February 2026; used for medical evacuations (2,746 patients and 4,065 companions by 29 October 2026, WHO via OCHA)

crossings.name: Kerem Shalom (Karm Abu Salem)
crossings.use: Goods: the main crossing for cargo
crossings.status_text: The crossing for UN and partner aid cargo: 586 trucks offloaded on 19–25 October 2026 (OCHA); also used for medical evacuations

crossings.name: Erez (Beit Hanoun)
crossings.use: People with Israeli permits (workers, patients, aid staff)
crossings.status_text: Destroyed in the attack of 7 October 2023; reopened for aid trucks on 1 May 2024 (Times of Israel, via Wikipedia); not listed as operating by OCHA in October 2026

crossings.name: Salah al-Din gate
crossings.status_text: Carried about 36% of Gaza's imports in 2023 (UNSCO, via Wikipedia); current status not reported by OCHA. Position approximate: about 4 km north-west of the Rafah crossing along the border
